urdu: کراچی سپر ہائی وے پر 5 جنوری کو کتنے افراد ایک حادثے میں جاں بحق ہوئے؟
english: How many people died in an accident on the Karachi Super Highway on January 5th?
roman_1: Karachi Super Highway par 5 January ko kitne afraad ek haadse mein jaan bahaq hue?
roman_2: Karachi Super Highway par 5 Jan ko kitnay afraad aik haadse mein jaan bahaq hoay?
roman_3: Karachi Super Highway pe 5 Jan ko kitne afraad ek haadse mei jaan bahaq hue?
